result.rationale: The model's before_validation only strips protocol and path (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and `self.host.sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`), never downcases, and the validation regex ends with `/i`, so mixed-case hosts like 'Example.com' can be stored. The query `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` in record_for_host lowercases only the DB column, not the parameter, so a stored mixed-case host will never match (URI-extracted referer hosts are lowercase). This is a verifiable defect introduced by the diff.

judged_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` lowercases only the `host` database column, not the bound `host` parameter, so an admin-entered mixed-case host (e.g. "Example.com") fails to match an incoming referer/embed-url whose extracted host differs only in case, silently rejecting an embed that the admin intended to allow.
